name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name. domain=string_ui, descriptor=render_decimal_format_template accurately reflects its role: a printf format-string template consumed by the UI decimal-number renderer. No Ghidra address residue in the name; reflects its data-type role (a format/template string). Keep.
purpose: Read-only printf format-string template "%0.5d" (zero-padded decimal) used by the UI to render integers as fixed-width decimal digit glyphs.
logic_summary: 6-byte char array {0x25,0x30,0x2e,0x35,0x64,0x00} = "%0.5d\0". Sole reader fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer (0x000187f3 load, 0x000187f8 MOVSD+MOVSW copies all 6 bytes) copies the template into a local stack buffer, overwrites byte[3] ('5') with ('0' + digit_count) to produce "%0.Nd" (N = 2 or 3), then sprintf()s the value with that local format string to zero-pad to N digits before blitting per-digit sprites. The global itself is never mutated; the byte[3] patch is on the local copy.
element_semantics: ASCII bytes of a printf conversion-spec string: '%','0','.','5','d',NUL. Read/copied byte-wise; byte index 3 ('5') is the precision digit that the reader rewrites on its local copy to set the zero-pad width.
